correctness.rationale: Reconstructed determinant F=a0*product_i a_i−sum_i b_i²*product_{j!=i}a_j and F=a_iF_i−b_i²P_i. Primitive linearity in a0 proves F and the two-leaf-or-larger F_i irreducible. For rank m, nonzero symmetric corank-one adjugate vv^t has a nonzero diagonal and one diagonal partial is nonzero; at rank<=m−1 all minors/partials vanish. Schur elimination at nonzero leaf diagonal positions leaves [[alpha,b_S],[b_S^t,0]] and classifies exactly the Z_i and triple-zero L_T strata. Deng–Kretschmer Theorem 1 proves the submaximal-minor ideal is radical for this sparse symmetric pattern, upgrading support to exact scheme-theoretic intersection. Listed height-three primes do not contain each other, Z_i complete-intersection degree m and L_T degree 1; generic transverse quadratic at Z_i is a_i F_i−b_i² unit, and at L_T the 3×3 Hessian determinant is nonzero in char!=2. Serre R1+S2 yields normality. Independently rank-enumerated all 10,934 projective coordinate patterns for m=3,4 over F_3; checked rank-deficient iff component membership. This is finite corroboration, not proof for all m.
